roles.title: Software Engineering Lead -> ML Engineering Lead (R&D AI Engineering)
highlights: Founded Sanofi's first AI engineering organization and scaled it to 70+ globally (7 direct reports, 30+ FTEs, 40+ contractors) across Toronto, Paris, and Boston.

Defined and executed the global AI infrastructure strategy: $12M+ HPC platform on NVIDIA A100/H100, EKS, FSx Lustre, and S3 - secured over a competing corporate platform via alignment with R&D, IT Security, Legal, and Finance.
Delivered platform architecture and budget strategy to SVP stakeholders within 6 weeks; blueprints and Terraform modules adopted by Vaccines and Small Molecule R&D as Sanofi's internal reference.

Shipped an event-driven LLM platform for automated clinical data analysis: vLLM-served models with FP8 quantization on ECS, EventBridge, and AWS Batch, with manifest-driven orchestration that scales to zero between workloads.
Standardized Terraform IaC and automated provisioning pipelines, improving throughput by 23%.
Operationalized protein models via SageMaker and Bedrock, reducing time-to-production by 26% across 7+ R&D teams.
Cut incident frequency 50%+ and onboarding time 40% through standardized CI/CD and async-first documentation.

roles.title: Technology Lead (Customer AI)
highlights: Managed a $5M ML infrastructure budget across a 5-person engineering team; established MLOps standards on GCP (GKE, Dataproc, Cloud Composer) and cut deployment cycles by 25%.
Directed a $3M personalization program: recommendation engine combining clickstream, transactional, and product data - 3% basket-size uplift and ~$13M/month incremental revenue.
Redesigned the price-elasticity platform on Snowflake, Vertex AI, Airflow, and Seldon: runtime 24h -> 4h and compute load reduced 32%.

roles.title: Data Engineer -> Senior Data Engineer -> Senior MLOps Engineer
highlights: Architected a promotion optimization platform serving 16 divisions and 200+ product categories on GCP Dataproc, Terraform, and Airflow, with Azure DevOps CI/CD and Azure SQL.

Built a precision segmentation platform processing 1B+ transactions/year from 21M loyalty members, powering $42M annual incremental revenue; the architecture became the backbone for Loblaw Media ($40M annual revenue).
Designed Loblaw's first ML decisioning engine for pricing and markdown timing, delivering $15-20M (~25%) annual revenue lift.
Developed a microservices orchestration framework achieving 73% batch latency reduction.

roles.title: Research Analyst (PPM Platform Engineering)
